title: Beef and Stir Fry
description: A simple beef and stir fry recipe with a nutty twist using dutch spices. Serve as a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: stir-fry veggies (such as bell peppers and onions)

instructions: Heat the nutty oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the dutch spice mix and stir to combine.
Add the fluffy mushrooms and stir-fry veggies, and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
